title: shap-synthetic-credit-risk
summary: A research project generating synthetic credit-risk tabular data with differential privacy, building a custom DPTVAESynthesizer that subclasses ctgan's TVAE internals with Opacus-based privacy accounting. It also uses SDV's SingleTableMetadata, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer to run standard baselines and metadata handling, with SDV's TVAE and CTGAN synthesizers extended and run for differentially private synthetic data generation.
evidence: src/synthetic/dp_tvae.py:11-14 imports TVAE from ctgan and TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table to build DPTVAESynthesizer with DP training
needs: directories models/ctgan and results/ctgan appear to be output/result folders, not verified as vendored source copies
